messages:
Mei Li: Hey folks — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 to add onboarding config for 'redwood-xl-3b' + a small tokenizer tweak (fallback for unseen bytes). Can someone do a quick review? aiming to canary tomorrow morning.

Omar Gomez: @Mei Li I'm +1 on the config schema shape, just skimmed. What's the tokenizer change exactly?

Mei Li: @Omar it adds a tiny fallback tokenization path for non-utf8 byte sequences and forces deterministic unk handling. Code diff is tiny: see tokenizer/byte_fallback.py — should be no behavioral change for normal inputs but fixes crashes on some internal logs.

ci-bot: tests failed on linux-x86_64: 
- model_onboard_tests::test_tokenizer_roundtrip (FAILED)
- perf_regression_check (REGRESSION: +3.1% p50 latency)
Full logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/9823

Alice Chen: repro steps for the tokenizer test? I can take the test failure.

Mei Li: repro: docker run -e TEST=tokenizer_roundtrip rwinference/test-runner:latest && pytest tests/test_tokenizer.py::test_tokenizer_roundtrip -k byte_fallback
The failure triggers with some legacy log inputs (I added a fixture in the PR).

Ravi Patel: I can look in ~2h. If the perf regression is real we need to be cautious to canary. Is the +3.1% p50 coming from tokenization overhead or a change in runtime config?

Mei Li: initial perf compare from the CI harness shows the regression correlated with the new quant profile selection logic I adjusted in model_config.yaml (preferred_profile: int8-mixed -> int8-fp16-mix). The tokenizer change alone shouldn't add latency. I included both changes in the PR to keep the onboarding self-contained.

Priya Nair: For the canary tomorrow, can we do a limited traffic rollout (10% traffic to dedicated pool) and extra telemetry? I can set up the telemetry dashboard if we merge.

Alice Chen: I dug into the failing test — small bug: the fixture expects a deterministic seed but the new fallback path used time-based seed in one branch. Pushing a one-line fix to the PR. Also added a unit test for the non-utf8 path. PR comment with patch in a sec.

Mei Li: awesome thanks @Alice. After that, can someone run the perf harness locally? here's the script: 

```
# perf run (local)
./tools/perf_run.sh --model redwood-xl-3b --profile int8-fp16-mix --batch-size 4 --seq 512
```

Ravi Patel: I'll run the harness after lunch and post results. If we still see >2% p50 regression we should revert the profile change and keep tokenizer change only, then re-evaluate.

Mei Li: noted. If the perf is within +/-2% we're fine. The canary has rollback hooks anyway. 

ci-bot: update: alice-chen pushed commit 7b3f9e0 — tests now passing on ubuntu-22.04. Perf harness queued (job 9844).

Ravi Patel: local perf run finished: p50 delta +0.6%, p95 delta +1.2%, throughput -0.8%. Memory/allocs unchanged. Those are within tolerance. Results: https://perf.redwood-inference.internal/runs/9844

Priya Nair: Great — I'll schedule a 10% canary window tomorrow 07:00 PT and wire extra logs for the tokenizer path. Also will attach a smoke test to auto rollback if p95 increases by >5% or error rate >0.5%.

Mei Li: thanks all. @Ravi can you leave an approval on the PR if you're happy? @Alice thanks for the fix. Once CI green and approval present I'll merge and trigger canary. :rocket:

Ravi Patel: Reviewed and approved — just one tiny nit on a comment but not blocking.

Alice Chen: CI green. LGTM.

Mei Li: merged and pushed canary deploy config. I'll watch metrics during the canary and follow up in #incidents if anything spikes.

Priya Nair: Canary started at 07:00 PT — dashboards live: https://dashboards.redwood-inference/internal/d/3b-onboard

ci-bot: canary monitoring: no regressions detected in first 30m.

Mei Li: closing loop — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Will open a follow-up to split the quant-profile change into a separate PR next week to reduce blast radius for future onboardings. :white_check_mark:
